description: This XML file defines a set of simple methods for Party-related operations in the Apache OFBiz framework, including person creation/updating, party group management, party content handling, and geolocation services.

methods.name: createPerson
methods.description: Creates a person entity using mapping processor and service call, with error checking and success message.

methods.name: updatePerson
methods.description: Updates an existing person entity by setting partyId and invoking the update service.

methods.name: createPartyGroup
methods.description: Creates a party group with mapping processing and service invocation, handling errors and returning partyId.

methods.name: updatePartyGroup
methods.description: Updates an existing party group with provided partyId.

methods.name: createPartyContent
methods.description: Uploads party content such as images, using layout worker methods and services, and sets request attributes.

methods.name: updatePartyContent
methods.description: Updates existing party content, similar to creation, with layout worker and service calls.

methods.name: editGeoLocation
methods.description: Creates or updates a geolocation point using external service and timestamps, based on presence of geoPointId.
